questions.text: Hikoyada asosiy voqealar ketma-ketligi qaysi zamonda beriladi?
questions.explanation: I woke up, got dressed and left — ketma-ket voqealar.

questions.text: Orqa fon va sahna qaysi zamonda tasvirlanadi?
questions.explanation: It was raining when the phone rang — fon + uzilish.

questions.text: Flashback (oldinroq bo'lgan voqea) qaysi zamonda beriladi?
questions.explanation: He had left before I arrived.

questions.text: «while/as» qaysi zamon bilan keladi?
questions.explanation: when + Past Simple (qisqa) ↔ while/as + Past Continuous (fon).

questions.text: Ketma-ket voqealarda Past Perfect kerakmi?
questions.explanation: Past Perfect faqat tartibni buzib, oldingi voqeaga qaytganda kerak.

questions.text: «I'll call you when I ___ » — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: when/as soon as/before/until/if dan keyin PRESENT — will emas.

questions.text: Future Continuous formulasi qanday?
questions.explanation: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to London.

questions.text: Future Perfect qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: I'll have finished by Friday — «...gacha tugallangan bo'ladi».

questions.text: «be about to» qanday ma'no beradi?
options: Juda yaqin payt — hozir sodir bo'ladi
questions.explanation: The bus is about to leave.

questions.text: Kelishilgan uchrashuv uchun qaysi shakl ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: I'm meeting Tom at 6. Jadval uchun esa Present Simple: The train leaves at 9.

questions.text: Second conditional formulasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Xayoliy/noreal hozir yoki kelajak: If I had money, I'd buy a car.

questions.text: «If I ___ you, I'd apologise» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: «If I were you» — maslahat berishning eng ko'p ishlatiladigan qolipi.

questions.text: «If I would have money...» — bu nega xato?
options: if-qismda would ishlatilmaydi — faqat Past Simple
questions.explanation: To'g'risi: If I had money, I would...

questions.text: First va Second conditional qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: If it rains, I'll stay (real) ↔ If I won the lottery, I'd travel (xayoliy).

questions.text: Natija qismida «would» o'rniga nima kelishi mumkin?
questions.explanation: If I had time, I could help you — imkoniyat yoki ehtimol ottenkasi.

questions.text: «unless» nimani anglatadi?
questions.explanation: I won't go unless you come — «unless» ichida allaqachon inkor bor.

questions.text: «I won't go unless you don't come» — bu nega xato?
options: unless ichida inkor bor — qo'sh inkor bo'lib qoladi
questions.explanation: To'g'risi: unless you come.

questions.text: «in case» va «if» qanday farqlanadi?
options: in case — ehtiyot uchun, OLDIN qilinadi; if — shart yuz bersa
questions.explanation: Take an umbrella in case it rains (oldindan) ≠ if it rains (yog'sa).

questions.text: «as long as / provided that» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: Ular ham Present zamon bilan keladi.

questions.text: «in case» dan keyin «will» ishlatiladimi?
questions.explanation: if/in case/unless dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi.

questions.text: «I wish I ___ the answer» (hozir bilmayman) — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: I wish + Past Simple — hozirgi holatdan afsus.

questions.text: «I wish I ___ harder» (o'tmishda o'qimadim) — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: I wish + Past Perfect — o'tmishdagi ishdan afsus.

questions.text: «I wish you would stop» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: wish + would — boshqa odamning harakati haqida shikoyat.

questions.text: «wish» va «hope» qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: I wish I were rich (noreal) ↔ I hope you pass the exam (real).

questions.text: «I wish I am rich» — bu nega xato?
options: wish dan keyin Present ishlatilmaydi: I wish I were rich
questions.explanation: if only — kuchliroq, hissiy variant: If only I had known!

title: Test — Majhul nisbat (Present va Past Simple)

questions.text: Passive formulasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Zamon «be» da ko'rsatiladi, V3 o'zgarmaydi.

questions.text: «The house ___ in 1990» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Past passive: was/were + V3. V2 emas, V3 ishlatiladi.

questions.text: «Men 2000-yilda tug'ilganman» qanday aytiladi?
questions.explanation: «be born» doim passive shaklda ishlatiladi.

questions.text: Passive qachon ishlatiladi?
options: Bajaruvchi noma'lum, muhim emas yoki ayon bo'lganda
questions.explanation: English is spoken here. Cars are made in Japan.

questions.text: «by» va «with» qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: written by Shakespeare ↔ cut with a knife.

title: Test — Passive: boshqa zamonlar va get

questions.text: «The car ___ repaired now» (hozir ta'mirlanyapti) — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Present Continuous passive: is/are BEING + V3.

questions.text: «being» va «been» qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: is being repaired (hozir) ↔ has been repaired (tugagan).

questions.text: «It must ___ done today» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Modal va will dan keyin BE + V3: must be done, will be finished.

questions.text: «I had my hair cut» — bu qanday qurilma?
questions.explanation: have/get + narsa + V3 — xizmatni boshqa kishi bajaradi.

questions.text: «got stolen, got fired» — bu qanday passive?
questions.explanation: Impersonal passive esa: It is said that... / He is said to be...

questions.text: «say» va «tell» qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: He said (that) he was tired. / He told me he was tired.

questions.text: «will» backshift da nimaga aylanadi?
questions.explanation: will→would, can→could, may→might, must→had to.

questions.text: «He said: “I am tired”» ni o'zlashtirmaga aylantiring
options: He said he has been tired
questions.explanation: is/are → was/were — bir qadam orqaga.

questions.text: «tomorrow» backshift da nimaga aylanadi?
questions.explanation: Vaqt so'zlari ham o'zgaradi: now → then, tomorrow → the next day.

questions.text: Gap hali rost bo'lsa backshift shartmi?
questions.explanation: would/could/should/might esa umuman o'zgarmaydi.
